title: Arya Forge: Auditing Validation and Release Approval for Financial Instruction Data
abstract: arXiv:2610.34778v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Financial instruction-data pipelines must distinguish content validity from permission to release a particular dataset. Arya Forge combines typed records, current-content checks, and approval coverage bound to a dataset manifest. We evaluate its release boundaries in a financial-data systems case study. An integrity audit covers 100,000 synthetic instruction records; a separate arithmetic implementation agrees with all 15,000 numeric records across twelve formula families. In 240 scenarios with 2,400 treatment rows, adding financial and release-record checks to a short-instruction filtering recipe rejects all injected numeric faults and policy holds while retaining 220 of 240 clean controls. The twenty lost controls comprise every tested cash-conversion-cycle example. Nineteen persisted-release cases show that eleven selected negative cases are blocked, four equivalent representations are rejected, and changes to external evidence after

translated_title: Arya Forge：金融指令数据的审计验证与发布审批
translated_abstract: 金融指令数据流水线必须区分内容有效性与发布特定数据集的许可权限。Arya Forge 将类型化记录、当前内容检查以及与数据集清单绑定的审批覆盖相结合。我们在一个金融数据系统案例研究中评估其发布边界。完整性审计涵盖 100,000 条合成指令记录；一个独立的算术实现与十二个公式族中的全部 15,000 条数值记录保持一致。在包含 2,400 个处理行的 240 个场景中，在短指令过滤方案中加入金融与发布记录检查后，所有注入的数值错误和政策保留均被拒绝，同时保留了 240 个干净对照中的 220 个。丢失的二十个对照包括所有被测试的现金转换周期示例。十九个持久化发布案例显示，十一个选定的负面案例被阻止，四个等价表示被拒绝，以及外部证据在……之后的变化（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: Arya Forge 将类型化记录、内容检查与绑定数据集清单的发布审批相结合，构建了一个能在金融指令数据流水线中拦截数值错误与政策违规、并区分内容有效性与数据发布许可的审计框架。
en_tdlr: Arya Forge is an audit framework combining typed records, current-content checks, and dataset-manifest-bound release approvals that effectively blocks injected numeric faults and policy holds in financial instruction-data pipelines while distinguishing content validity from release permission.
